testcase.name: remote policy removes previously selected local binding without losing concurrency guards
listing follows all pages and retains uncertain sessions until durable release
lost close response retries the same operation; a released session is not closed again
closing refuses changed scope and rechecks a blocked review only on a later attempt
no format puts the key in the URL
the claude command sends the key in a Bearer header
the codex command reads the key from OKTO_NEXUS_API_KEY
JSON formats carry the Bearer header next to the URL
newItems skips messages that the toast logic already reported
isNewForOperator needs an unread delivery to the operator
isNewForOperator ignores deliveries at or before the seen marker
toastText prefers the subject, then the preview
tail validates exact cursor, session, executor and epoch before displaying events
tail retains loaded scrollback and does not duplicate events on refresh
scrollback merges overlapping earlier pages without losing concurrent live events
Codex joins streaming text and snapshots and pairs independent tool calls
Claude renders tool input fragments only once complete and merges assistant snapshots and results
Pi normalizes user messages, streams, tools, final message and turn echo
empty events and protocol frames produce no blank activity or JSON
fallback keeps readable errors, approvals and future harness actions without revealing protected fields
identical replies in different turns are retained
partial history pages keep complete text and strip terminal control sequences

claude_stream: delivery input separates the request from readable context
pi_rpc: delivery input separates the request from readable context
long streamed responses retain their final suffix beyond the former 32K limit
Claude authoritative final replaces streamed text while failed tools retain their inputs
native input requests, aborted replies and empty status notifications stay distinguishable

claude_stream: canonical text and terminal holdback replace masked native fields
pi_rpc: canonical text and terminal holdback replace masked native fields
canonical snapshots respect empty holdback and never duplicate native Pi final snapshots
masked-only native fields do not become blank tools or placeholder text

the last session, an open session and another agent are not restarts
